title: Turn one optimisation pass off for the function

rewrite.template:
#pragma push
#pragma opt_common_subs off   /* or opt_lifetimes / opt_propagation / opt_dead_assignments off */
<fn>
#pragma pop
rewrite.description: Most frequent single fix. opt_common_subs off first, then opt_lifetimes, opt_propagation, opt_dead_assignments. Not allowed in onmokoworks' worker output.

tool: python3 -I tools/pragmasweep.py fn UNIT FN --set all [--objdiff]

title: Build the TU with another compiler version

rewrite.template: mw_version="GC/2.6" (or 1.3, 1.2.5n) on the Object() in configure.py
rewrite.description: Check every matched fn in the TU stays 100. Prologue `mflr; stw r0,4(r1); stwu` = 1.2.5n; `li rN,-0x100` colour not r0 + rlwimi = GC/2.x; const-sourced load hoisted above a store = GC/2.6.

tool: python3 -I tools/pragmasweep.py fn UNIT FN (sweeps compilers)

title: `li rN,-0x100` + rlwimi colour lands in r0: TU is GC/2.x, write `0xFFFFFF00 | (u8)a`

rewrite.template:
unsigned char al = (int)(255.0f * a);
SetColor(0xFFFFFF00 | al);   /* TU on GC/2.6 */
rewrite.description: Every matched fn with this shape and rN != r0 is in a GC/2.x TU. A 1.3.2 TU faking it with __rlwimi colours the constant r0.

title: Reorder local declarations

rewrite.template: (solver output)
rewrite.description: Named locals are numbered in REVERSE declaration order. regfix solves it exactly for up to ~11 locals; inline locals are a separate order.

tool: python3 -I tools/regfix.py diag UNIT FN  (or pragmasweep --decl)

title: A compiler temp must be numbered next to a local: give the value a named local

rewrite.template:
T tN = <expr>;   /* declared where the solver says */
... tN ...
rewrite.description: The default realisation of a regfix 'renumber temp X next to local Y' diagnosis. Read the value one statement earlier or later if a plain hoist does nothing.

tool: python3 -I tools/shapesweep.py UNIT FN --moves hoist,unvar  then regfix solve

title: Call result through an inline `return f(...)` takes the wrong dying saved reg: name the result in the inline

rewrite.template: static inline int *F(...) { int a; int *ret; int b; ...; ret = Call(...); return ret; }
rewrite.description: Sweep the named result's declaration position among the variables that die at the call (n+1 compiles).

title: Stop an inline from modifying its parameter and returning it; return the expression

rewrite.template:
static inline int F(int chute, int index) { return chute == 2 ? index + 2 : index; }
/* not: if (chute == 2) index += 2; return index; */
rewrite.description: A parameter that is reassigned inside the inline becomes an extra temp. Returning an expression removes it.

title: Advance a cursor through an inline in/out parameter

rewrite.template:
static inline void Next(void ***cursor) { ... (*cursor)++; }
/* then index = byte offset / sizeof(void *) */
rewrite.description: A walker that the target keeps in a separate register from the base: route it through a pointer-to-cursor inline.

title: Compute an element address only where it is used; drop manual pointer increments

rewrite.template: if (cond) { Face *face = &faces[count]; ... }   /* no out++ / p += size walkers */
rewrite.description: Fewer strength-reduced pointers means fewer hidden temps competing for the target's registers.

title: Index through the full expression instead of a cached pointer

rewrite.template: grid->cells[index].tris   /* not: Cell *c = &grid->cells[index]; c->tris */
rewrite.description: The inverse of temp-to-local: a named pointer forces an extra live range the target does not have.

title: Write repeated per-point code as a small local array plus a counted loop (fully unrolled by MWCC)

rewrite.template:
Vec3f control[3] = {a, b, c};
for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) { ... control[i] ... }
rewrite.description: An unrolled loop gets different temps from three written-out copies; the scratch registers match the target's.

title: Initialise the counter in the caller and pass its address to the inline

rewrite.template:
int n = 0;
Fill(&n, ...);   /* inline increments *n */
rewrite.description: Moves the zero constant and the counter into the caller's numbering.

title: Replace a C++ implicit member copy with a memberwise C static inline

rewrite.description: Implicit operator= has its own load/store order and also changes function emission order.

title: Match the declaration to the real definition (drop a wrong const, fix the element type)

rewrite.template: extern int lbl_804EC5E8[65];   /* the shared header had const */
rewrite.description: const lets MWCC hoist loads over stores (GC/2.6) and CSE them; a mismatch changes schedule and registers.

title: Change only the integer type of a local (int / long / unsigned)

rewrite.template: long clamp;   /* was int */
rewrite.description: int, long and unsigned int are different IR types: the register can move with identical instructions.

title: Rewrite the loop's index arithmetic (p=&a[i] / p++ / base+i*size, shared or scoped counters)

rewrite.template: x = 0x3C + g*0xBB;  /* position from the index, not a running counter */
rewrite.description: Strength reduction creates hidden IVs. Try all of: computed position, p++, &a[i], one shared function-scope i, a scoped counter per loop.

title: Move a loop (or one of several identical blocks) into a static inline helper

rewrite.template: static inline void Fill(T *p, int n) { int i; for (i = 0; i < n; i++) ... }
rewrite.description: An inlined body gets its own temps and a deeper priority; changes the SR init (`mr`) and which dying reg a walker reuses. If only one of several identical blocks differs, some were inline expansions.

title: A caller local reused by several switch cases is numbered below the loop temps: give each case an inline helper with its own local

rewrite.template:
static inline void CreateX(const char *name) { Menu *m = Create(name, 1); if (m != 0) { for (int i = 0; ...) Add(m, tbl[i]); } }
/* case 0: CreateX(s + 0x5d8); break;   instead of: menu = Create(...); if (menu) ...; */
rewrite.description: regfix diag says 'X is a named local, numbered below every temp: turn it into a temp'. A function-scope local shared by several cases cannot be renumbered by decl order; moving each case body (create + null check + loop) into its own static inline turns it into an inline local with a fresh number. Then re-run the decl-order step for the remaining named locals (a block-scoped loop variable moved to function scope).

title: An inline's local must be numbered above a temp created earlier: declare it in the outer inline/caller and pass it by reference

rewrite.template:
static inline void Inner(T *self, const char *file, unsigned long &size) { if (file) { size = ...; ... } }
static inline void Outer(...) { const char *file; unsigned long size; ...; Inner(self, file, size); }
rewrite.description: regfix diag 'create temp @B (an inline local) after temp @A (an earlier inline param/local)' = @B needs a lower @ number than it gets, i.e. it must be created earlier in the frontend. Declaring the variable one inline level up (after the variable it must follow) and passing it by reference does that; the reference is folded away. Sweep its position among the outer inline's locals.

title: Target keeps &local in a saved GPR across a loop: declare before the loop and pass via a pointer variable

rewrite.description: Moving the declaration alone does nothing; a pointer local inside an inline is propagated away.

title: List iterator kept in a stack slot: derived iterator class passed by value to an inline

rewrite.description: Plain iterator classes are always registerised; a trivial dtor also does it but adds extab.

title: Reorder independent statements

rewrite.template: (stmtsweep output)
rewrite.description: Statement order changes vreg creation order and the scheduler's input; R5 bc31b3a, TextRenderer_DrawEntry 783ff7e.

title: Change expression form: component/store order, operand order, assignment inside a call arg

rewrite.template:
out->y = ...; out->z = ...; out->x = ...;   /* target store order */
f(y = 300 - 4*a);   /* temp assigned inside the call arg */
rewrite.description: Changes the expression DAG, not the variables. Call args are evaluated right to left.

title: Use float literals instead of `extern const float lbl_...`

rewrite.template: x = 1.0f;   /* not lbl_806D28CC */
rewrite.description: Literals can be CSE'd and hoisted, extern consts are memory loads. postprocess_sdata2 maps @N back to lbl_ names.

title: Vector x 4x4 matrix with translation: inner products parenthesised, translation as the outer left operand

rewrite.template:
float y = v->y; float x = v->x; float z = v->z;
out->x = m[3][0] + (z*m[2][0] + (x*m[0][0] + y*m[1][0]));
rewrite.description: Exact in Mtx44_TransformVec3 (GC/1.3.2 C). fn_8019EB9C (GC/2.6 C++) is still 8 lines off with this family: the late m[3][2] load + z fadds operand order.

title: Load scheduled above a store: read through a const pointee (GC/2.6) or __restrict

rewrite.template: const T *self;   /* or float (*__restrict src)[4] */
rewrite.description: GC/2.6 hoists loads over stores only from const sources; 1.3.2 never does. __restrict reproduces software-pipelined copies. If __restrict on self fixes one hoist but also hoists a self-> load over a store to a global that the target keeps in order, drop __restrict and declare the hoisted global `extern const` instead (fn_8024AD8C).

title: Long copy run: regroup statements so the 26-statement scheduling region breaks where the target's does

rewrite.template: dst->blk = src->blk;   /* one 16-byte struct copy instead of 4 statements */
rewrite.description: Count statements from the block start; merge/split statements to move the break.

title: Value in r0 but target uses r4..r7: route a nearby load through that value

rewrite.template: LNode **a = &l->f4; e.n = (LNode *)a; b.n = a[1];   /* not e.n = &l->f4; b.n = l->head; */
rewrite.description: r0 can't be a load base; once the value is used as a base it skips r0.

title: Chained `a = b = 0` gives the zero the counter's register

rewrite.template: p->n = j = 0;   /* fakematch if not natural */
rewrite.description: Fakematch rule applies: mark with the natural code.

title: Extra lis/addi or missing `addi rX, rBase, 0`: the TU must own the pooled data (not a source-shape fix)

rewrite.template: splits.txt: .rodata/.data start..end on the TU; define the objects as real statics in source order
rewrite.description: Anchor needs >=3 compiler-local objects; named globals never. A static object behind the anchor gives 'first access folded, rest through a pointer'.

title: Local lifetimes: lexical blocks, reuse one variable, split or merge locals

rewrite.template: { int t; ... }   /* scope a local to its block, or reuse dy for the next value */
rewrite.description: Group 'Local lifetimes / lexical blocks / variable reuse' of the onmokoworks Codex fixes.

title: Move the function boundary: add, remove or reshape an inline helper

rewrite.template: static inline T Helper(...) { ... }
rewrite.description: Group 'Inline helper / function boundary' of the onmokoworks Codex fixes (36, the largest).

title: Literal vs extern constant (int or float)

rewrite.template: 1.0f / 0x10   vs   extern const float lbl_...
rewrite.description: Group 'Literal vs extern constant' of the onmokoworks Codex fixes.

title: Part of the function is the body of an already-matched function: the original inlined it

rewrite.template: static inline void Helper(T *c, ...) { <verbatim body of the matched sibling> }
rewrite.description: Run `tools/asmgrep.py similar UNIT FN` (or grep the TU's distinctive globals/strings in src/) and look for a MATCHED function whose whole body appears as a run inside the near miss. Copy that body verbatim as a static inline and call it. The sibling's named locals become inline temps, which are numbered above the caller's locals and so are coloured earlier: this is the usual realisation of the regfix diagnosis "named local X must be numbered above temp Y". Values the caller already holds in a saved register (a string base) go in as parameters.

auto: regfix fix: moves `inline[plain|argdecl] NAME: stmts i..j` (extract the run holding a diagnosed local's live range into a static inline) + `boolnorm` (x = a != 0 <-> a ? 1 : 0, also inside the helper). Replays fn_8024D3D4 (needs both). Not covered: b27f188 (by-value iterator type), eb9631d (macros->inlines + __restrict).

title: Unrolled run of stores in the target, but ours keeps a pointer CSE'd across it: write the run as a loop

rewrite.description: The target re-loads a pointer (e.g. lwz r3, 0x20(rSelf)) at the start of an unrolled run of stores that ours takes from a register still live from an earlier read of the same field (our extra use moves the earlier temp to another register). MWCC unrolls small constant loops in the backend, after frontend CSE, so the original wrote the run as a loop; hand-unrolled stores get CSE'd with the earlier read.

title: Local must be coloured right before a later inline's temps: compute it through a nested (level-2) inline

rewrite.description: MWCC expands inlines level by level (all direct calls first, in statement order, then their callees). A named local is coloured after every temp; a level-1 inline puts it before all later level-1 inlines' temps. Wrapping it two levels deep creates its temps after the level-1 inlines' locals but before loop-opt temps.

tool: python3 -I tools/regfix.py diag UNIT FN  (look for 'X is a named local ... turn it into a temp' with the wanted spot between later temps)

title: Loop unrolled 4x in the target but 8x in ours (or not the same scheme): up-counting loop + #pragma opt_unroll_instr_count 16

rewrite.template:
#pragma push
#pragma opt_unroll_instr_count 16
... fn ...
#pragma pop
/* loop: for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++) { *dst++ = ...; p += 2; } */
rewrite.description: An unsigned count-down loop (for (; n > 0; n--)) gets the 4x srwi./andi. unroll but its guard is simplified to beq; the up-counting i < n loop gives the target's cmplwi/ble guard but MWCC unrolls it 8x. Lowering the unroll budget (opt_unroll_instr_count 16, GC/1.3.2) brings the up-counting loop to the target's 4x shape.
